```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=6)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(tidyverse); library(paletteer); library(knitr); library(kableExtra) })
source('src/report_style.R'); source('src/report_io.R'); set_report_style()
out <- 'removed_genes_characterization'; dir.create(out, showWarnings=FALSE, recursive=TRUE)
num <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
gene <- read_tsv(file.path(params$profile_dir,'gene_profile.tsv'), show_col_types=FALSE, progress=FALSE)
pos <- read_tsv(file.path(params$profile_dir,'position_profile.tsv'), show_col_types=FALSE, progress=FALSE)
pfam <- if (file.exists(file.path(params$profile_dir,'pfam_by_category.tsv')))
  read_tsv(file.path(params$profile_dir,'pfam_by_category.tsv'), show_col_types=FALSE, progress=FALSE) else NULL
lv <- c('Normal','Extreme','Dubious','Both')
gene$category <- factor(gene$category, lv); pos$category <- factor(pos$category, lv)
palette <- report_palette(10); colors <- c(Normal=palette[10],Extreme=palette[3],Dubious=palette[1],Both=palette[7])
has <- function(df, ...) all(c(...) %in% names(df)) && any(!is.na(df[[c(...)[1]]]))
removed <- gene %>% filter(category != 'Normal')
w <- as.numeric(params$window_mb)
```

# Scope

Genes are grouped by the verdict of the gene filter on the observed discovery: **Normal** (retained)
and the three removed categories **Extreme** (CAAS count above the far fence of the gene-length stratum),
**Dubious** (above the near fence and carrying a cluster train) and **Both**. All genes are the CT candidates of the run
(`r nrow(gene)` genes, `r sum(gene$category!='Normal')` removed). A *cluster train* is a CAAS position flagged by the selected
cluster filter. Every comparison is descriptive: the filter selects genes on CAAS count, which grows with gene length, so
each removed gene is compared with Normal genes of its own length stratum (stratum residuals) and not with the whole set.
The contrasts on CAAS count and CAAS per kb of section 1 hold by construction, since the filter selects on them; they are shown as a
reference for the other metrics.
Positions are alignment columns (0-based, `CAAS_0based`).

```{r counts}
gene %>% group_by(Category=category) %>% summarise(Genes=n(), Median_length=median(length), Median_CAAS=median(n_CAAS),
  Positions=sum(n_positions,na.rm=TRUE), Train_positions=sum(n_train,na.rm=TRUE), .groups='drop') %>%
  kable(caption='Genes by filter category') %>% kable_styling(full_width=FALSE)
```

```{r helpers}
# Value minus the median of the Normal genes of the same length stratum; the contrast of each removed category with Normal uses
# a Wilcoxon rank-sum test on these residuals, BH-adjusted over the metrics and categories of one table.
resid_table <- function(df, metrics) {
  rows <- map_dfr(names(metrics), function(m) {
    d <- df %>% filter(is.finite(.data[[m]])) %>% group_by(stratum) %>%
      mutate(res = .data[[m]] - median(.data[[m]][category=='Normal'], na.rm=TRUE)) %>% ungroup()
    ref <- d$res[d$category=='Normal']
    map_dfr(setdiff(lv,'Normal'), function(k) {
      x <- d$res[d$category==k]
      if (length(x) < 3 || length(ref) < 3) return(NULL)
      tibble(Metric=metrics[[m]], Category=k, n=length(x), Median=median(d[[m]][d$category==k]),
             Median_residual=median(x), p=wilcox.test(x, ref)$p.value)
    })
  })
  if (nrow(rows)) rows$q <- p.adjust(rows$p, 'BH')
  rows
}
box <- function(df, y, lab, title) {
  pp_plot(ggplot(df %>% filter(is.finite(.data[[y]])), aes(category, .data[[y]], fill=category)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size=.6, alpha=.85) + scale_fill_manual(values=colors, guide='none') +
    labs(title=title, x=NULL, y=lab), file.path(out, paste0(y, '.png')), width=8, height=5)
}
```

# 1. Gene size and CAAS load

```{r size}
g <- gene %>% mutate(caas_per_kb = n_CAAS / length * 1000)
box(g, 'length', 'Gene length (aligned columns)', 'Length by filter category')
box(g, 'n_CAAS', 'CAAS candidates per gene', 'CAAS count by filter category')
rt <- resid_table(g, c(length='Length', n_CAAS='CAAS count', caas_per_kb='CAAS per kb'))
write_tsv(rt, file.path(out,'size_residuals.tsv')); pp_show(rt, 'Stratum-adjusted contrasts with Normal genes (descriptive)')
```

# 2. Variability

Variability is the Valdar score of each alignment column (`1 - C_trident`, 0 = conserved, 1 = fully variable).
BMGE has already trimmed the alignments, so the gap fraction is a residual quality measure.

## 2.1 Whole gene

```{r var-gene, results='asis'}
if (has(gene,'gene_mean_variability')) {
  box(gene, 'gene_mean_variability', 'Mean column variability', 'Whole-gene variability')
  box(gene, 'gene_mean_gap', 'Mean gap fraction', 'Whole-gene gap fraction')
  rt <- resid_table(gene, c(gene_mean_variability='Gene mean variability', gene_mean_gap='Gene mean gap fraction',
                            pct_variable='Percent variable columns'))
  write_tsv(rt, file.path(out,'variability_gene_residuals.tsv')); pp_show(rt, 'Stratum-adjusted contrasts with Normal genes')
} else cat('No gene variability table supplied.\n\n')
```

## 2.2 CAAS positions against the rest of the gene

Within each gene the mean variability of its CAAS columns is paired with that of all its other columns. Cluster-train
positions are shown apart.

```{r var-pos, results='asis'}
if (has(gene,'caas_mean_variability','mean_variability_noncaas')) {
  long <- gene %>% select(Gene, category, `CAAS columns`=caas_mean_variability, `Cluster-train columns`=train_mean_variability,
                          `Other columns`=mean_variability_noncaas) %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(Gene,category), names_to='Set', values_to='variability') %>% filter(is.finite(variability)) %>%
    mutate(Set=factor(Set, c('Other columns','CAAS columns','Cluster-train columns')))
  pp_plot(ggplot(long, aes(Set, variability, fill=Set)) + geom_boxplot(outlier.size=.5, alpha=.85) +
    facet_wrap(~category, nrow=1) + scale_fill_manual(values=unname(palette[c(10,2,4)]), guide='none') +
    labs(title='Variability of CAAS columns, cluster trains and the rest of each gene', x=NULL, y='Mean column variability') +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30, hjust=1)), file.path(out,'variability_sets.png'), width=11, height=5.5)
  d <- gene %>% filter(is.finite(caas_mean_variability), is.finite(mean_variability_noncaas)) %>%
    group_by(Category=category) %>% summarise(Genes=n(), CAAS=median(caas_mean_variability), Other=median(mean_variability_noncaas),
      Median_paired_difference=median(caas_mean_variability-mean_variability_noncaas), .groups='drop')
  write_tsv(d, file.path(out,'variability_caas_vs_rest.tsv')); pp_show(d, 'CAAS columns minus other columns, per gene')
  if (any(is.finite(gene$caas_mean_gap_fraction))) {
    rt <- resid_table(gene, c(caas_mean_gap_fraction='Gap fraction at CAAS columns'))
    pp_show(rt, 'Gap fraction at CAAS columns, stratum-adjusted')
  }
} else cat('No per-column variability supplied (position_variability_dir).\n\n')
```

# 3. Pfam domains

```{r pfam, results='asis'}
if (has(gene,'n_pfam_columns')) {
  # Alignment columns come from the variability tables; without them the column fraction is not computed.
  if (!'n_columns' %in% names(gene)) gene$n_columns <- NA_real_
  gene <- gene %>% mutate(pfam_column_fraction = replace_na(n_pfam_columns,0)/n_columns)
  p <- pos %>% group_by(Category=category) %>% summarise(Positions=n(), `CAAS in a Pfam domain`=mean(in_pfam),
    Train_positions=sum(train), `Train in a Pfam domain`=mean(in_pfam[train]), .groups='drop')
  cov <- gene %>% group_by(Category=category) %>% summarise(`Gene columns in a Pfam domain`=median(pfam_column_fraction), .groups='drop')
  tab <- left_join(p, cov, by='Category'); write_tsv(tab, file.path(out,'pfam_overlap.tsv'))
  pp_show(mutate(tab, across(where(is.double), ~round(.x,3))), 'Fraction of columns inside a Pfam domain')
  if (!is.null(pfam)) {
    totals <- gene %>% count(category, name='category_genes')
    for (lev in c('clan','pfam')) {
      t <- pfam %>% filter(level==lev) %>% left_join(totals, by=c('category'='category')) %>%
        mutate(gene_fraction=genes/category_genes)
      wide <- t %>% filter(category!='Normal') %>% left_join(t %>% filter(category=='Normal') %>%
        select(term, normal_gene_fraction=gene_fraction), by='term') %>%
        mutate(normal_gene_fraction=replace_na(normal_gene_fraction,0)) %>%
        arrange(category, desc(genes)) %>% group_by(category) %>% slice_head(n=15) %>% ungroup()
      write_tsv(t, file.path(out, paste0(lev,'_by_category.tsv')))
      cat(sprintf('\n\n## Most frequent %s terms of the removed genes\n\n', if (lev=='clan') 'Pfam clan' else 'Pfam domain'))
      pp_show(wide %>% transmute(Category=category, Term=term, Genes=genes, Gene_fraction=round(gene_fraction,3),
        Normal_gene_fraction=round(normal_gene_fraction,3), CAAS_positions=caas_positions, Train_positions=train_positions),
        'Gene fraction is within each category; Normal gives the background frequency')
    }
  }
} else cat('No Pfam table supplied.\n\n')
```

# 4. Ultraconserved regions (UCR)

```{r ucr, results='asis'}
if ('ucr_region' %in% names(pos)) {
  u <- pos %>% count(category, ucr_region) %>% group_by(category) %>% mutate(fraction=n/sum(n)) %>% ungroup() %>%
    mutate(ucr_region=factor(ucr_region, c('core','flank','none')))
  pp_plot(ggplot(u, aes(category, fraction, fill=ucr_region)) + geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values=unname(palette[c(2,4,10)]), name='UCR region') +
    labs(title='UCR region of the CAAS columns', x=NULL, y='Fraction of CAAS positions'),
    file.path(out,'ucr_region.png'), width=8, height=5)
  write_tsv(u, file.path(out,'ucr_region.tsv'))
  tr <- pos %>% filter(train) %>% count(category, ucr_region) %>% group_by(category) %>% mutate(fraction=round(n/sum(n),3))
  pp_show(tr, 'UCR region of cluster-train positions')
} else cat('No UCR table supplied.\n\n')
```

# 5. FUBAR selection calls

```{r fubar, results='asis'}
if ('is_pos_hit' %in% names(pos)) {
  f <- pos %>% group_by(Category=category) %>% summarise(Positions=n(), `With a FUBAR call`=sum(!is.na(prob_pos)),
    `Positive (diversifying)`=sum(is_pos_hit==1, na.rm=TRUE), `Negative (purifying)`=sum(is_neg_hit==1, na.rm=TRUE),
    `Median P(positive)`=median(prob_pos, na.rm=TRUE), .groups='drop') %>%
    mutate(`Positive %`=round(100*`Positive (diversifying)`/`With a FUBAR call`,2),
           `Negative %`=round(100*`Negative (purifying)`/`With a FUBAR call`,2))
  write_tsv(f, file.path(out,'fubar_caas.tsv')); pp_show(f, 'FUBAR calls at the CAAS columns')
  g2 <- gene %>% filter(n_fubar_sites > 0) %>% mutate(pos_fraction=n_fubar_pos/n_fubar_sites, neg_fraction=n_fubar_neg/n_fubar_sites)
  box(g2, 'pos_fraction', 'Fraction of sites with positive FUBAR hit', 'Whole-gene FUBAR positive fraction')
  box(g2, 'neg_fraction', 'Fraction of sites with negative FUBAR hit', 'Whole-gene FUBAR negative fraction')
} else cat('No FUBAR table supplied.\n\n')
```

# 6. Genomic location

Windows of `r w` Mb on the genome. For each window the number of removed genes is compared with its expected number if removal
were independent of position (binomial, with the share of all candidate genes in that window as probability);
BH-adjusted over the windows with candidates.

```{r genomic, results='asis'}
ann <- pp_table(params$gene_ensembl_file, c('gene','chr','start','end')) %>% pp_numeric(c('start','end'))
sym <- function(x) sub('\\.[A-Z][a-z]+_[a-z]+(_[A-Za-z0-9]+)*$', '', sub('\\.prot$', '', x), perl=TRUE)
gg <- gene %>% mutate(symbol=sym(Gene)) %>% inner_join(ann %>% select(symbol=gene,chr,start,end) %>% distinct(symbol,.keep_all=TRUE),
        by='symbol') %>% filter(is.finite(start), is.finite(end)) %>%
  mutate(window=floor((start+end)/2/(w*1e6)), removed=category!='Normal')
cat(sprintf('%d of %d genes have a genomic annotation.\n\n', nrow(gg), nrow(gene)))
if (nrow(gg) && any(gg$removed)) {
  N <- nrow(gg); R <- sum(gg$removed)
  win <- gg %>% group_by(chr, window) %>% summarise(candidates=n(), removed_genes=sum(removed),
    Extreme=sum(category=='Extreme'), Dubious=sum(category=='Dubious'), Both=sum(category=='Both'), .groups='drop') %>%
    mutate(start_mb=window*w, end_mb=(window+1)*w, expected=R*candidates/N, ratio=removed_genes/expected,
      p=pbinom(removed_genes-1, R, candidates/N, lower.tail=FALSE)) %>%   # P(X >= observed)
    mutate(q=p.adjust(p,'BH'))
  chrs <- win %>% mutate(n=suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub('^chr','',chr)))) %>% distinct(chr,n) %>%
    arrange(is.na(n), n, chr) %>% pull(chr)
  win <- win %>% mutate(chr=factor(chr, chrs)) %>% arrange(chr, window)
  write_tsv(win, file.path(out, 'removed_genes_windows.tsv'))
  pp_plot(ggplot(win, aes(window*w, removed_genes/pmax(candidates,1))) +
    geom_col(fill=colors[['Both']]) + facet_grid(.~chr, scales='free_x', space='free_x') +
    labs(title=sprintf('Fraction of candidate genes removed per %g-Mb window', w), x=sprintf('Position (%g-Mb windows)', w),
         y='Removed / candidate genes') + theme(axis.text.x=element_blank(), panel.spacing=unit(.1,'lines')),
    file.path(out,'removed_windows.png'), width=14, height=4.5)
  pp_show(win %>% filter(removed_genes > 0) %>% arrange(p) %>% mutate(across(c(expected,ratio), ~round(.x,2)),
    across(c(p,q), ~signif(.x,3))) %>% select(chr, start_mb, end_mb, candidates, removed_genes, Extreme, Dubious, Both,
    expected, ratio, p, q), 'Windows with removed genes, ordered by p')
}
```

# 7. Removed genes

```{r list}
cols <- intersect(c('Gene','category','length','n_CAAS','n_positions','n_train','gene_mean_variability','caas_mean_variability',
  'mean_variability_noncaas','n_pfam_domains','n_ucr_core_columns','n_fubar_pos'), names(gene))
rg <- removed %>% select(all_of(cols)) %>% arrange(category, desc(n_CAAS)) %>% mutate(across(where(is.double), ~round(.x,3)))
write_tsv(rg, file.path(out,'removed_genes_profile.tsv')); pp_show(rg, 'Removed genes and their profile')
```
